mostWorthwhile.text: Getting rain to remain on the ground brought the chapter’s cooling and water-cycle processes together.

leastWorthwhile.text: The sequence of recycling water through the sky felt somewhat repetitive, despite its useful explanation.

surprise.text: Rain returned to steam on hot rock even after a separate patch of ground had become cool enough to retain water; the distinction was somewhat confusing.

arbitrary.text: Combining rain with the still-hot volcanic surface felt awkward after cooling the ground, although it demonstrated that the water returned to the atmosphere rather than disappearing.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how the accumulated water becomes a sea, though I would hope for fewer repetitive cooling steps.
